title: Brown spoke of biblical UFOs and aliens with his family

tellings.quote: I also learned from Townsend Brown's daughter, Linda, that the inventor would constantly speak of biblical UFOs and aliens behind closed doors and with his family.

plain: The inventor Thomas Townsend Brown, who worked on unusual propulsion, is said to have talked constantly about UFOs in the Bible and about aliens, privately and with his family. Michels says he learned this from Brown's daughter, Linda Brown, which would show the inventor's private beliefs went far beyond his public work.
